Blade Profile Editor

Forge study

Stage

Refined is the finished 100% blade. The 90% blade adds the edge allowance to it. The universal blank is shared by every blueprint and isn't edited here.

Sori is the curve's height above a straight line from base to point, as sword catalogues list it.

Selected point

Drag points to reshape. Double-click to add a point. Select a point and press Delete to remove it. Scroll to zoom the outline and drag empty space to pan.

Catalogue measurements

Type the numbers a sword catalogue lists (cm) to rebuild the refined outline, then derive the in-between forging stages from it.

Tang

Reference image

Load a side photo or drawing to trace over. Base on the left, edge at the bottom; flip it if needed.
